name: Bio-Cement
description: Cement produced by bacteria that precipitate calcium carbonate when fed nutrient solution. Mix bacteria, nutrients, and sand; wait a few days; get concrete. Bio-cement requires no kiln, no high temperatures, and no industrial infrastructure. Tier 1 communities use it to harden sand into structural blocks using nothing but sugar water and the right bugs.
